id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Point-to-point Source -> Sink over the Main Link (1/2/4 lanes) plus a bidirectional AUX channel and HPD sideband (SST). MST extends this to a tree of Sinks via branch devices (hubs / daisy chain) with virtual channels and a 64-slot time-slot allocation.

supported_topologies.name: SST point-to-point
supported_topologies.description: One Source -> one Sink over 1/2/4 Main Link lanes.

supported_topologies.name: MST tree
supported_topologies.description: Source -> branch device -> multiple Sinks; each stream a virtual channel with allocated time slots.

supported_topologies.name: MST daisy chain
supported_topologies.description: Sinks chained through DisplayPort-out ports (branch function).

supported_topologies.name: Embedded DisplayPort (eDP)
supported_topologies.description: Source -> internal panel with Panel Self-Refresh / Panel Replay.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Drives the Main Link, masters the AUX channel, reads DPCD/EDID, trains the link, streams video.
Receives the Main Link, replies on AUX, exposes DPCD + EDID, reports training status, drives HPD.
MST hub/repeater routing multiple streams via Sideband MSG and the time-slot table.
Bidirectional half-duplex management channel shared by the link.

fields.interconnect_role: DisplayPort is a Source-to-Sink display transport. The Main Link carries isochronous video uni-directionally; the AUX channel carries all management (DPCD, training, EDID, MST sideband, HDCP) bidirectionally. In MST the branch device routes multiple streams to multiple Sinks.

ordering_guarantees.stream_order: Per-stream video is isochronous and in-order; Transfer-Unit / MSA framing preserves the raster.
ordering_guarantees.mst_arbitration: MST allocates fixed time slots per virtual channel so streams do not starve each other.
ordering_guarantees.aux_order: AUX is strictly half-duplex request/reply, one transaction at a time.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: DisplayPort's addressable space is the DPCD register map (20-bit AUX address) plus the I2C address space reached by I2C-over-AUX (EDID at A0h). The Main Link video stream is addressless isochronous data.

device_classification.host_router: Contains the Connection Manager + host interface adapter.
device_classification.source: GPU/SoC DisplayPort transmitter: masters AUX, trains the Main Link, streams video.
device_classification.sink: Monitor/panel DisplayPort receiver: exposes DPCD + EDID, reports status, drives HPD.
device_classification.branch_device: MST hub/daisy-chain router using Sideband MSG and the 64-slot table.
device_classification.edp_panel: Embedded DisplayPort internal panel with Panel Replay.

default_signal_values_evidence_tables: VESA DisplayPort Standard — Main Link rates (RBR/HBR/HBR2/HBR3, UHBR10/13.5/20) and lane counts (1/2/4)
DPCD register-map structure (Receiver Capability / Link Configuration / Link Status)
Link-training procedure (Clock Recovery + Channel Equalization, swing/pre-emphasis)
AUX transaction format (4-bit command, 20-bit address, ACK/NACK/DEFER) and I2C-over-AUX EDID
